verses.text: What was there from the jump—what we heard, what we saw with our own eyes, what we looked at and touched with our hands—that’s the Word of life we’re talking about.
This life showed up, and we saw it. We’re witnesses. We’re telling you about the eternal life that was with the Father and showed up for real.
What we’ve seen and heard, we’re passing on to you—so you can be in this with us. And our squad’s connected to the Father and His Son, Jesus Christ.
We’re writing this so our joy can be full—yours and ours.
Here’s the message we heard from Him and now tell you: God is light. No darkness in Him. None.
If we say we’re vibing with Him but still walk in the dark, we’re capping and not living the truth.
But if we walk in the light like He’s in the light, we’re in real community, and the blood of Jesus cleanses us from every sin.
If we say we’ve got no sin, we’re lying to ourselves. Truth’s not in us.
But if we confess our sins, He’s faithful and just to forgive and clean us up from all the mess.
If we say we’ve never sinned, we’re calling Him a liar—and His word isn’t living in us.
My little crew, I’m writing this so you don’t mess up—but if you do, we’ve got Jesus, our defense lawyer with the Father.
He’s the real one who took the hit for our sins—and not just ours, but the whole world’s.
Here’s how we know we actually know Him: we keep His commands.
If someone says, “I know Him,” but doesn’t follow His commands—they’re capping, and the truth’s not in them.
But whoever keeps His word—God’s love is fully lit in them. That’s how we know we’re in Him.
If you say you’re in Him, walk like He walked.
Dear fam, I’m not dropping a new command, but the OG one you’ve had since day one—it’s the word you already know.
But also, it’s new—because the darkness is fading and the real light’s already shining.
If someone says they’re in the light but hates their sibling, they’re still in the dark.
Whoever loves their sibling stays in the light—no tripping, no stumbling.
But whoever hates is in the dark, walking blind, not knowing where they’re going.
I’m writing to you, little ones—your sins are forgiven because of His name.
I’m writing to you, fathers—you’ve known the One from the beginning. I’m writing to you, young ones—you’ve beat the evil one.

I’ve written to you, kids—you know the Father. I’ve written to you, fathers—you’ve known Him from the jump. I’ve written to you, young ones—you’re strong, God’s word lives in you, and you’ve clapped the evil one.
Don’t love the world or what it flexes. If you do, the Father’s love isn’t in you.
Everything the world pushes—cravings, ego, status—isn’t from the Father, but from the world.
The world’s fading fast, along with its hype. But whoever does God’s will lives forever.
Little crew, it’s the last hour. You’ve heard antichrist is coming—and now many are already here. That’s how we know it’s endgame.
They dipped out from us, but they were never really with us. If they were, they’d have stayed. Their exit exposed the fake.
But you’ve got the anointing from the Holy One—and you know what’s real.
I’m not writing because you don’t know the truth, but because you do—and no lie comes from the truth.
Who’s the liar? The one who denies Jesus is the Christ. That’s the antichrist—denying the Father and the Son.
No one who denies the Son has the Father. But whoever confesses the Son has the Father too.
So let what you heard from the start stay in you. If it does, you’ll stay connected to the Son and the Father.
And this is the promise He gave us—eternal life.
I’m writing this about those trying to throw you off.
But the anointing you got from Him stays in you. You don’t need anyone to teach you—His anointing teaches you everything. It’s real, not fake. Stay in Him like it taught you.
And now, little crew, stay locked in with Him, so when He shows up, we won’t be shook—we’ll stand bold at His return.
If you know He’s righteous, then you know everyone who does right is born of Him.
Yo, look at this wild love the Father gave us—we’re actually called God’s kids. The world doesn’t get it, ‘cause it doesn’t know Him.
Fam, we’re God’s children right now. And what we’ll be next? That’s still loading. But when He shows up, we’ll be like Him—‘cause we’ll see Him as He is.
Everyone hoping in Him stays clean—just like He’s clean.
Anyone who keeps sinning is breaking God’s law. Sin is straight-up rebellion.
You know Jesus showed up to erase sins—and in Him, there’s zero sin.
If you stay in Him, you don’t keep sinning. If you keep sinning, you don’t know Him or see Him.
Little crew, don’t let anyone trick you. If you do what’s right, you’re righteous—just like He is.
Whoever keeps sinning is on the devil’s team. The devil’s been sinning since day one. But Jesus came to shut the devil down.
If you’re born of God, you don’t keep living in sin—God’s DNA is in you. You can’t keep sinning when you’re born of Him.
That’s how you spot God’s kids vs. the devil’s crew: if you don’t do right or don’t love your sibling, you’re not with God.
This is the message you’ve heard from the start: love one another.
Don’t be like Cain—he was with the evil one and killed his brother. Why? ‘Cause his own life was wicked and his brother’s was righteous.
Don’t be shocked if the world hates you, fam.
We know we’ve crossed from death to life—‘cause we love our siblings. If you don’t love, you’re still stuck in death.
Anyone who hates their sibling is a murderer. And you know no murderer has eternal life living in them.
This is how we know love: Jesus laid down His life for us. So we should lay ours down for our siblings.
If you’ve got stuff and see your sibling struggling, but you shut your heart—how’s God’s love even in you?
Little crew, don’t just talk love. Live it. Show it. Make it real.
That’s how we know we’re legit—and how we calm our hearts when they’re bugging out.
Even if our hearts accuse us, God’s bigger than our hearts. He knows everything.
Fam, if our hearts aren’t tripping, we can be bold with God.
And whatever we ask, we get—‘cause we keep His commands and do what makes Him smile.
And here’s His command: trust in Jesus, His Son, and love each other like He told us.
Whoever keeps His commands stays in Him, and He in them. And we know He lives in us—‘cause of the Spirit He gave us.
Dear crew, don’t believe every spirit—test the vibes to see if they’re from God. There’s a lot of fake prophets out here.
Here’s how you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that says Jesus came in the flesh is legit.
But if they deny Jesus came in the flesh, that’s not from God—that’s the antichrist spirit you heard was coming, and it’s already in the world.
You, fam, are from God and already beat them—‘cause greater is the One in you than the one in the world.
They’re from the world, so they talk world talk—and the world vibes with them.
We’re from God. Whoever knows God listens to us. If they don’t, they’re not from Him. That’s how you know the Spirit of truth vs. the spirit of lies.
Dear crew, let’s love each other—‘cause love comes from God. Everyone who loves is born of God and knows Him.
If you don’t love, you don’t know God—‘cause God is love.
This is how God showed His love: He sent His one and only Son into the world so we could live through Him.
Real love isn’t that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son to take the hit for our sins.
Fam, if God loved us like that, we should definitely love each other.
No one’s seen God, but if we love each other, He lives in us—and His love is fully lit in us.
This is how we know we live in Him and He in us: He gave us His Spirit.
We saw it and testify—the Father sent the Son to save the world.
If anyone says, “Jesus is the Son of God,” God lives in them, and they in God.
We’ve come to know and trust the love God has for us. God is love. If you live in love, you live in God, and God lives in you.
Love is made complete in us so we can be bold on judgment day—‘cause we’re repping Him in this world.
There’s no fear in love. Real love kicks fear out. Fear has to do with punishment, and if you’re still scared, love hasn’t hit full power in you yet.
We love because He loved us first.
If someone says, “I love God,” but hates their sibling—they’re lying. If you can’t love the one you see, how can you love the One you haven’t seen?
And this is the command we got from Him: whoever loves God must love their sibling too.
If you believe Jesus is the Christ, you’re born of God. And if you love the Parent, you’ll love the kids too.
Here’s how we know we love God’s fam: when we love God and follow His commands.
Loving God means keeping His commands—and they’re not heavy or extra.
Everyone born of God beats the world. What wins the fight? Our faith.
Who beats the world? The one who believes Jesus is God’s Son.
Jesus Christ came by water and blood—not just water, but water *and* blood. And the Spirit backs it, ‘cause the Spirit is truth.
There are three that testify in heaven—the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost—and they’re one.
And three that testify on earth—the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and they agree.
If we trust human testimony, God’s testimony is way bigger. And this is what He says about His Son.
Whoever believes in the Son has that witness inside. Whoever doesn’t is calling God a liar—‘cause they don’t believe what He said about His Son.
And this is the testimony: God gave us eternal life, and that life is in His Son.
If you’ve got the Son, you’ve got life. If you don’t, you don’t.
I wrote this to you who believe in Jesus so you know you’ve got eternal life—and keep believing.
This is the confidence we’ve got: if we ask anything that lines up with His will, He hears us.
And if we know He hears us, we know we’ve already got what we asked for.
If you see a sibling sinning—not a sin that leads to death—pray, and God will give them life. But there is sin that leads to death—I’m not saying pray for that.
All wrongdoing is sin, but not all sin leads to death.
We know whoever’s born of God doesn’t keep sinning. The One born of God keeps them safe, and the evil one can’t touch them.
We know we’re from God, and the whole world’s under the grip of the evil one.
And we know the Son of God came and gave us understanding so we can know the Real One. We’re in Him who’s true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
Little crew, keep yourselves away from idols. No fakes. No substitutes.
